reason: Cetus primarily orchestrates multiple agent runtimes through a macOS desktop assistant layer, combining quick launch, scheduled background runs, context capture, and review workflows; the README also documents sensitive screen/audio access and computer control.

summaries.zh: Cetus 是一款 macOS 桌面智能体编排应用，可统一启动和管理多个运行时、安排后台任务，并提供屏幕上下文与工作结果审阅功能。
summaries.en: Cetus is a macOS desktop orchestration app that unifies multiple agent runtimes, schedules background tasks, and provides screen context and work-review features.

capabilities: Orchestrates multiple agent runtimes and background conversations
Schedules one-off and recurring agent jobs
Captures screen context and performs on-device OCR
Transcribes microphone and system audio for meeting memory
Controls browsers and Mac applications with confirmation steps
Runs installed agent CLIs and supports isolated git worktrees
